newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Generale Bank to buy U.S. fund mngr Harbour - media.
newsitem.headline: Generale Bank to buy U.S. fund mngr Harbour - media.

text.p: Generale Bank, Belgium's largest bank, will announce the purchase later today of U.S. fund management company Harbour Capital Management for about $94 million, Belgian media said on Wednesday.
The bank will hold a news conference at 0900 GMT on the expansion of its core business lines, but has declined to give further details ahead of time.

From Boston, where Harbour Capital Management is located, Karen Smith, vice-president of marketing, said Harbour Capital Management would not be making any comment on the proposed takeover for 48 hours. She did not elaborate.
